reasons: Both answers meet every rubric item with accurate core content: Article 220, limits of 2 million and 3 million roubles, a refund capped by the tax paid, and replies entirely in Russian. B adds useful practical detail, including the finishing costs, per-spouse family totals, the effective date of the right and the caveat for deductions used before 2014. It also gives more precise clause references, although one of them is slightly off, and its opening sentence is a little self-contradictory.

B: Cites п. 8 ст. 220 for the rule that the mortgage-interest deduction is allowed only once; that clause covers the employer route, and the ban on a repeat deduction is in п. 11.
